intent.ko: 어제 무엇을 끝냈고 오늘은 무엇을 할지 말해보세요
intent.en: Tell them what you finished yesterday and what you are moving on to today.

wk_003.sample_en: I finished the draft yesterday, and today I'm moving on to the test results. There was one small issue with the data.

sample_gloss.ko: 어제 초안을 끝냈고 오늘은 테스트 결과로 넘어간다는 뜻이에요. 데이터에 작은 문제가 하나 있었다고 덧붙였어요.
sample_gloss.en: You finished the draft yesterday and are starting on the test results today, and you mention one small data problem.

intent.ko: 어느 팀에서 주로 어떤 일을 맡고 있는지 말해보세요
intent.en: Tell them which team you are on and what you mainly take care of.

gloss.en: I belong to the support team
I am mainly in charge of

wk_005.sample_en: I'm on the support team, and I mostly handle orders from our overseas clients. Day to day, that means a lot of email.

sample_gloss.ko: 지원팀에서 해외 거래처 주문을 주로 맡고 있고, 평소에는 메일 업무가 많다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You are on the support team, you mainly handle overseas client orders, and most days that means a lot of email.

intent.ko: 소리가 끊겨 미안하다고 하고 일정 이야기를 다시 말해보세요
intent.en: Say your audio dropped, then say your point about the schedule again.

wk_008.sample_en: Sorry about the audio. Let me say that again: the launch date may get pushed back a week.

sample_gloss.ko: 소리가 끊긴 것을 사과하고, 출시 날짜가 일주일 밀릴 수 있다는 말을 다시 전하는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You apologize for the audio trouble and repeat that the launch date may slip by a week.

intent.ko: 내일 회의에서 다룰 것 두 가지를 정해서 말해보세요
intent.en: Say the two things you want tomorrow's meeting to cover.

wk_011.sample_en: Two things mainly. I'd like to go over the budget first, and then the timeline for next quarter.

sample_gloss.ko: 크게 두 가지를 다루자는 뜻이에요. 예산을 먼저 보고, 그다음에 다음 분기 일정을 보자고 했어요.
sample_gloss.en: You want to cover two things: the budget first, and after that next quarter's timeline.

intent.ko: 목요일은 어렵고 며칠 더 필요하다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say Thursday is too tight and ask for a few more days.

gloss.en: is Monday all right for you?

wk_014.sample_en: Thursday would be tight. If I could have a couple more days for the checks, would Monday work?

sample_gloss.ko: 목요일까지는 빠듯하다는 뜻이에요. 확인할 시간이 이틀쯤 더 있으면 월요일은 어떤지 물었어요.
sample_gloss.en: Thursday is too tight, and you ask whether Monday would work if you get two or three more days for checks.

intent.ko: 공장 일정이 밀려 샘플이 늦어진다고 알리고 새 날짜를 말해보세요
intent.en: Tell them the factory is behind and give the new date for the samples.

wk_017.sample_en: The factory is running a bit behind, so we can ship next Friday instead. I'll keep you posted if anything changes.

sample_gloss.ko: 공장 일정이 조금 밀려서 다음 금요일에 보낼 수 있다는 뜻이에요. 달라지면 계속 알려주겠다고 했어요.
sample_gloss.en: The factory is a little behind, so the samples ship next Friday instead, and you will keep them updated.

intent.ko: 무엇이 잘못됐고 지금 어떻게 하고 있는지 짧게 말해보세요
intent.en: Say briefly what went wrong and what you are doing about it now.

wk_020.sample_en: The short version is that one batch was affected by a labeling error. We're already working on it and I'll have numbers by noon.

sample_gloss.ko: 라벨 오류로 한 묶음이 영향을 받았다는 뜻이에요. 이미 처리 중이고 정오까지 숫자를 드리겠다고 했어요.
sample_gloss.en: In short, one batch was hit by a labeling error, you are already on it, and numbers will come by noon.

intent.ko: 원자재 값이 올라 견적이 높아졌다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Tell them the quote is higher because material costs went up this year.

gloss.en: it is about the raw material

wk_023.sample_en: The difference is on the raw material, which is up since last year. Everything else is at the same margin as before.

sample_gloss.ko: 차이가 난 건 원자재 쪽이고 작년보다 값이 올랐다는 뜻이에요. 나머지는 예전과 같은 이윤이라고 했어요.
sample_gloss.en: The gap comes from the raw material, which costs more than last year, while everything else keeps the same margin.

intent.ko: 일정 단축이 무리라고 생각하는 이유를 말해보세요
intent.en: Say you think the shorter schedule is too tight, and give your reason.

wk_026.sample_en: I'm a little worried about the testing time. What if we keep the date but drop one of the smaller features?

sample_gloss.ko: 테스트 시간이 걱정된다는 뜻이에요. 날짜는 그대로 두고 작은 기능 하나를 빼면 어떻겠냐고 제안했어요.
sample_gloss.en: You are concerned about the testing time and suggest keeping the date but dropping one smaller feature.

intent.ko: 숫자가 틀린 경위를 인정하고 어떻게 바로잡았는지 말해보세요
intent.en: Say how the wrong number got in and how you are fixing it.

wk_029.sample_en: That was my mistake. I pulled the old file by accident, so I've already sent a correction to everyone on the list.

sample_gloss.ko: 본인 실수였다고 인정하는 뜻이에요. 예전 파일을 잘못 썼고, 받은 사람 모두에게 정정본을 이미 보냈다고 했어요.
sample_gloss.en: You own the mistake, explain you used the old file by accident, and say a correction already went to everyone.

intent.ko: 예약이 있는데 확인이 안 된다고 하고 다시 찾아봐 달라고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say you have a booking that is not showing, and ask them to look again.

wk_031.sample_en: I'm checking in tonight, but it may be saved under the company name instead of mine. Could you check again?

sample_gloss.ko: 오늘 밤 체크인인데 예약이 회사 이름으로 되어 있을 수 있다는 뜻이에요. 다시 확인해 달라고 부탁했어요.
sample_gloss.en: You are checking in tonight, the booking may be under the company name, and you ask them to look again.

intent.ko: 생산 라인에 대해 무엇이 궁금한지 한 가지만 말해보세요
intent.en: Say you have one question about how the line runs, and ask it.

wk_034.sample_en: I do have one question about output. How many units does this line run in a shift?

sample_gloss.ko: 생산량에 대해 하나 묻고 싶다는 뜻이에요. 이 라인이 한 교대에 몇 개를 만드는지 물었어요.
sample_gloss.en: You have one question about output and ask how many units this line produces in a single shift.

intent.ko: 지금 어디까지 왔고 무엇이 남았는지 한두 문장으로 말해보세요
intent.en: Say where the project stands now and what is still left.

wk_037.sample_en: We're about halfway through and on schedule so far. The one thing left this month is the client review.

sample_gloss.ko: 절반쯤 왔고 아직 일정대로라는 뜻이에요. 이번 달에 남은 건 고객 검토 하나라고 했어요.
sample_gloss.en: You are about halfway and still on schedule, and the only thing left this month is the client review.

intent.ko: 오늘 저녁은 어렵지만 다른 날은 괜찮다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say tonight does not work for you, and offer another day.

wk_040.sample_en: I wish I could, but I already have plans tonight. How about tomorrow instead, if your schedule allows?

sample_gloss.ko: 가고 싶지만 오늘은 선약이 있다는 뜻이에요. 일정이 괜찮다면 내일은 어떤지 물었어요.
sample_gloss.en: You would like to go but already have plans tonight, and you offer tomorrow if their schedule allows.

intent.ko: 다섯 시에는 다른 회의가 있고 여섯 시 이후면 된다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say five does not work because of another meeting, and offer after six.

gloss.en: five does not work for me
I have a meeting at that hour

wk_042.sample_en: I'm afraid I can't make five. I have another meeting then, but any time after six works for me.

sample_gloss.ko: 다섯 시에는 다른 회의가 있어 어렵다는 뜻이에요. 대신 여섯 시 이후면 언제든 괜찮다고 했어요.
sample_gloss.en: Five does not work because you have another meeting, but any time after six is fine for you.

intent.ko: 휴가 동안 누구에게 무엇을 물으면 되는지 말해보세요
intent.en: Tell them who to go to for what while you are away next week.

wk_045.sample_en: For anything urgent, please go to the team lead. I'll be back on Monday and can pick up the rest then.

sample_gloss.ko: 급한 일은 팀장에게 물어봐 달라는 뜻이에요. 월요일에 돌아와서 나머지는 이어받겠다고 했어요.
sample_gloss.en: Urgent things go to the team lead, and you will pick up the rest when you are back on Monday.

intent.ko: 주문이 들어온 뒤의 순서를 차례대로 말해보세요
intent.en: Tell them the steps, in order, from the moment an order comes in.

wk_048.sample_en: First we check that the stock is there. Then it goes to the warehouse team, and once that's done I send the confirmation.

sample_gloss.ko: 먼저 재고를 확인한다는 뜻이에요. 그다음 창고팀으로 넘기고, 그게 끝나면 확인 메일을 보낸다고 했어요.
sample_gloss.en: First you check the stock, then it goes to the warehouse team, and once that is done you send the confirmation.

intent.ko: 먼저 사과하고 바로 무엇을 해 드릴지 말해보세요
intent.en: Say you are sorry, then say exactly what you will do to fix it.

wk_051.sample_en: I'm so sorry about this. Let me send the right one out today at no cost, and we'll collect the wrong item.

sample_gloss.ko: 먼저 사과하는 뜻이에요. 맞는 물건을 오늘 무료로 보내고 잘못 간 물건은 회수하겠다고 했어요.
sample_gloss.en: You apologize, then say you will send the correct item today at no cost and collect the wrong one.

intent.ko: 지금 예산으로는 어렵고 무엇이 더 필요한지 말해보세요
intent.en: Say the budget is not enough, and tell them what it would take.

wk_054.sample_en: Not with this budget, I'm afraid. We're about twenty percent short, so we'd need a little more room or a smaller scope.

sample_gloss.ko: 지금 예산으로는 어렵다는 뜻이에요. 이십 퍼센트쯤 모자라서 예산을 더 받거나 범위를 줄여야 한다고 했어요.
sample_gloss.en: This budget is not enough; you are about twenty percent short, so you need a bit more room or a smaller scope.

intent.ko: 결정된 내용과 누가 무엇을 할지 짧게 정리해서 말해보세요
intent.en: Say what was agreed and who is doing what next.

wk_057.sample_en: So we agreed on the shorter list for now. I'll take care of the supplier call and send the summary by next Friday.

sample_gloss.ko: 짧은 목록으로 가기로 했다는 뜻이에요. 공급사 통화는 본인이 맡고, 정리본은 다음 금요일까지 보내겠다고 했어요.
sample_gloss.en: You agreed on the shorter list, you will handle the supplier call, and you will send the summary by next Friday.

intent.ko: 세 시는 어렵고 네 시는 괜찮다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say three does not work for you, and suggest four instead.

gloss.en: three does not work for me

sample_001.sample_en: Sorry about that, I can't make three. How about four instead?

sample_gloss.ko: 세 시는 어렵다고 말하고 네 시는 어떤지 물어보는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You say three does not work for you and ask whether four would be all right instead.

intent.ko: 비용 자료를 본 뒤 다음 주에 정하자고 말해보세요
intent.en: Suggest waiting until next week so you can look at the cost data first.

wk_060.sample_en: Could we hold off until next week's meeting? I'd like to see the full numbers before we commit.

sample_gloss.ko: 전체 수치를 본 뒤 결정하고 싶으니 다음 주 회의까지 미루자는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You ask to wait until next week's meeting so you can see all the figures before deciding.

intent.ko: 대부분 이해했지만 약어 하나는 뜻을 모르겠다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say you follow most of it, but ask what one acronym means.

wk_061.sample_en: I'm mostly with you, thanks. Quick question though: what does SLA stand for?

sample_gloss.ko: 대부분 이해했다고 하면서 SLA가 무엇의 약자인지 묻는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You say you follow most of it and ask what SLA is short for.

intent.ko: 좋은 질문이라고 받은 뒤 수치의 출처를 짧게 말해보세요
intent.en: Acknowledge the question and briefly explain where the number comes from.

gloss.en: that's a fair thing to ask

wk_062.sample_en: Good question. It comes from our online sales only, and I'm happy to share the full breakdown after this.

sample_gloss.ko: 좋은 질문이라며, 그 수치는 온라인 매출만 기준이고 끝나고 세부 자료를 공유하겠다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: The figure is based on online sales only, and you offer to send the full breakdown afterward.

intent.ko: 제 쪽에서 공유가 안 되니 링크를 채팅에 올리겠다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say sharing isn't working on your side and offer to post a link in the chat.

wk_063.sample_en: Give me a second, it's not working on my end. I'll put the link in the chat for now.

sample_gloss.ko: 제 쪽에서 공유가 안 되니 우선 채팅창에 링크를 올리겠다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: Sharing fails on your side, so you will post the link in the chat for now.

intent.ko: 다음 일정이 있으니 남은 안건은 메일로 하자고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say you have another call and suggest handling the last item by email.

wk_064.sample_en: We're already over time, and I have another call at eleven. Could we pick that up over email?

sample_gloss.ko: 이미 시간이 넘었고 11시에 다른 통화가 있으니 그 안건은 메일로 이어가자는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: The meeting has run long and you have a call at eleven, so you suggest continuing by email.

intent.ko: 출시 일정을 짧게 다루고 싶다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Ask to spend a few minutes on the launch date.

wk_065.sample_en: Yes, one thing to add. I'd like to talk about the launch date, five minutes at most.

sample_gloss.ko: 추가할 게 하나 있다며, 출시 일정을 길어야 5분 정도 이야기하고 싶다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You want to add the launch date to the agenda and keep it to five minutes.

intent.ko: 늦어서 미안하고 앞 회의가 길어졌다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Apologize for being late and say your last meeting ran over.

wk_066.sample_en: Sorry I'm late, my last meeting ran over. Please go ahead, I'll catch up.

sample_gloss.ko: 앞 회의가 길어져 늦었다고 사과하고, 따라갈 테니 계속 진행해 달라는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You apologize because your previous meeting went long and ask them to carry on.

intent.ko: 내가 이해한 결론을 짧게 말하고 맞는지 확인해 달라고 말해보세요
intent.en: Repeat the decision as you understood it and check that it is right.

wk_067.sample_en: Just to confirm, we keep the old design and only change the colors. Is that right?

sample_gloss.ko: 기존 디자인은 유지하고 색만 바꾸는 것으로 이해했는데 맞는지 확인하는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You check that the decision is to keep the current design and only change the colors.

intent.ko: 이름과 용건, 다시 연락받을 번호를 말해보세요
intent.en: Give your name, the reason for calling, and a number to call back.

wk_068.sample_en: Hi Mark, this is Minji from Hanul, calling about the May order. You can reach me at 010 1234 5678.

sample_gloss.ko: 한울의 민지인데 5월 주문 건으로 전화했고, 이 번호로 연락 달라는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You say who you are, that you are calling about the May order, and leave your number.

intent.ko: 여기는 회계팀이 아니고 연결해 주겠다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say they have the wrong team and offer to transfer them.

wk_069.sample_en: I'm afraid not, this is the sales team. Let me put you through to accounting.

sample_gloss.ko: 여기는 회계팀이 아니라 영업팀이라며 회계팀으로 연결해 주겠다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You explain this is sales, not accounting, and offer to transfer the call.

intent.ko: 잠깐 끊어서 400개가 맞는지 다시 확인해 달라고 말해보세요
intent.en: Politely cut in and check that the quantity is four hundred.

wk_070.sample_en: Sorry to interrupt, just to check. Was that four hundred units on the 12th?

sample_gloss.ko: 말을 끊어 미안하다고 하고, 12일에 400개가 맞는지 확인하는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You cut in politely to check that it is four hundred units on the 12th.

intent.ko: 창고에 확인하고 오늘 3시 전에 다시 전화하겠다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say you will check and call them back before three this afternoon.

wk_071.sample_en: Let me check with the warehouse and call you back before three. Is this number okay?

sample_gloss.ko: 창고에 확인한 뒤 3시 전에 다시 전화하겠다며, 이 번호로 하면 되는지 묻는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You will ask the warehouse and phone back before three, and check that this number is fine.

intent.ko: 동료도 들을 수 있게 스피커폰으로 바꿔도 되냐고 말해보세요
intent.en: Before starting, ask if you can switch to speaker so a teammate can listen.

wk_072.sample_en: Before we start, is it okay if I put you on speaker? My colleague Jun is here with me.

sample_gloss.ko: 시작 전에 스피커폰으로 바꿔도 되는지 묻고, 동료 준이 같이 있다고 알리는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You ask if you can switch to speakerphone and say your coworker Jun is with you.

intent.ko: 결정하기 전에 샘플 몇 개를 보내 달라고 말해보세요
intent.en: Ask them to send a few samples before you decide.

wk_073.sample_en: Could you send a few samples to our Seoul office? We'd like to test them before we decide.

sample_gloss.ko: 결정하기 전에 시험해 보고 싶으니 서울 사무실로 샘플 몇 개를 보내 달라는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You ask for some samples at the Seoul office so you can test them before deciding.

intent.ko: 선금은 30%까지만 되고 나머지는 납품 때 내겠다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say you can only do thirty percent up front and pay the rest on delivery.

wk_074.sample_en: Our policy is thirty percent up front. Could we pay the rest on delivery?

sample_gloss.ko: 회사 방침상 선금은 30%이고 나머지는 납품 때 내도 되는지 묻는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: Company rules allow 30 percent in advance, and you ask to pay the balance when it arrives.

intent.ko: 법무 검토 때문에 다음 주 수요일까지 시간을 달라고 말해보세요
intent.en: Ask for time until next Wednesday because legal is still reviewing it.

wk_075.sample_en: It's still with legal, so we need a few more days. Could we say by next Wednesday?

sample_gloss.ko: 아직 법무팀이 검토 중이라 며칠 더 필요하니 다음 주 수요일까지로 하자는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: Legal is still reviewing it, so you ask to move the date to next Wednesday.

intent.ko: 사과하고 사진을 받으면 이번 주에 교체품을 보내겠다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Apologize, ask for photos, and promise replacements within the week.

wk_076.sample_en: I'm really sorry to hear that. If you send us some photos, we'll ship replacements this week.

sample_gloss.ko: 정말 죄송하다며, 사진을 보내 주면 이번 주에 교체품을 보내겠다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You apologize and promise to ship new units this week once they share pictures.

intent.ko: 가격은 못 내리지만 대신 배송비를 부담하겠다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say you can't lower the price, but offer to cover shipping instead.

gloss.en: the best price we can offer

gloss.ko: 대신 해 드릴 수 있는 건
gloss.en: what we are able to offer

wk_077.sample_en: I'm sorry, this is already our lowest price. What we can do is cover the shipping on your next order.

sample_gloss.ko: 이미 최저가라 더 못 내리지만, 다음 주문의 배송비를 부담하겠다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: The price can't go lower, but you offer to pay for delivery on the next order.

intent.ko: 다음 달 초 사흘 쉬고 싶고 일은 미리 정리하겠다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Ask for three days off early next month and say your work will be covered.

gloss.en: at the start of next month

wk_078.sample_en: I'd like to take three days off early next month. I'll have everything covered before I go.

sample_gloss.ko: 다음 달 초에 사흘 쉬고 싶고, 가기 전에 일을 다 처리해 두겠다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You ask for three days of leave early next month and promise all work will be handled first.

intent.ko: 오늘 밤은 어렵지만 내일 아침 일찍 끝내겠다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say tonight doesn't work, but offer to finish first thing tomorrow.

wk_079.sample_en: Tonight is difficult for me, I have plans. I can come in first thing tomorrow and have it done by ten.

sample_gloss.ko: 오늘 밤은 선약이 있어 어렵고, 내일 아침 일찍 와서 10시까지 끝내겠다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You have plans tonight, so you offer to come in early tomorrow and finish by ten.

intent.ko: 수식이 안 되는데 잠깐 봐 줄 수 있는지 말해보세요
intent.en: Say a formula isn't working and ask if they could take a quick look.

wk_080.sample_en: This formula keeps breaking and I can't see why. Do you have a minute for a quick look?

sample_gloss.ko: 이 수식이 계속 오류가 나는데 이유를 모르겠으니 잠깐 봐 줄 수 있는지 묻는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You say the formula keeps failing and ask if they have a minute to check it.

intent.ko: 전체적으로 좋지만 합계가 틀린 것 같다고 부드럽게 말해보세요
intent.en: Say it looks good overall, but gently point out that the total seems off.

wk_081.sample_en: It looks good overall. The total might be off, though, so could you check it again before sending?

sample_gloss.ko: 전체적으로 좋지만 합계가 틀렸을 수도 있으니 보내기 전에 다시 확인해 달라는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: It's fine in general, but the total could be wrong, so you ask them to check before sending.

intent.ko: 오늘은 어렵고 다음에 같이 가자고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say you can't today and suggest another time.

wk_082.sample_en: I wish I could, but I'm eating at my desk today. Can I take a rain check?

sample_gloss.ko: 같이 가고 싶지만 오늘은 자리에서 먹어야 하니 다음에 가자는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You'd love to go, but you are eating at your workstation today, so you ask for another time.

intent.ko: 맡을 수 있지만 지금 하는 일과 어느 쪽이 먼저냐고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say yes, but ask which should come first, the report or your current work.

wk_083.sample_en: I'm happy to help. I'm also on the client deck this week, so which comes first?

sample_gloss.ko: 기꺼이 맡겠지만 이번 주에 고객 발표 자료도 하고 있으니 무엇이 먼저인지 묻는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You agree, but since you are also on the client slides, you ask what the priority is.

intent.ko: 기사가 이름 팻말을 들고 입국장에서 기다린다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Tell them a driver will wait at arrivals holding a sign with their name.

wk_084.sample_en: Our driver will meet you at arrivals, holding a sign with your name. He'll take you straight to the hotel.

sample_gloss.ko: 기사가 이름 팻말을 들고 입국장에서 기다리다가 호텔로 바로 모셔다 드린다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: A driver with a name sign will wait in the arrivals hall and take them straight to the hotel.

intent.ko: 이 층에 누가 있고 다음에 어디로 갈지 말해보세요
intent.en: Tell them who works on this floor and where you will go next.

wk_085.sample_en: This is where the design team sits. After this, we'll head upstairs to the lab.

sample_gloss.ko: 이 층은 디자인팀 자리이고, 다음에는 위층 연구실로 간다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: This floor is where the designers sit, and next you will go up to the lab.

intent.ko: 맵지 않은 불고기를 추천하고 이유를 짧게 말해보세요
intent.en: Recommend bulgogi, a mild dish, and briefly say why.

gloss.en: if beef is okay for you

wk_086.sample_en: If you like beef, try the bulgogi. It's not spicy at all, and most people love it.

sample_gloss.ko: 소고기를 좋아하면 불고기를 드셔 보라며, 전혀 맵지 않고 다들 좋아한다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: If beef is okay for them, you suggest bulgogi because it has no heat and is a favorite.

intent.ko: 지금 하는 일과 경력, 지원 이유를 짧게 말해보세요
intent.en: Briefly say what you do now, how long you have done it, and why you applied.

wk_087.sample_en: I currently work in logistics and have done so for five years. Now I'm looking for a bigger role in global sales.

sample_gloss.ko: 지금 물류 분야에서 5년째 일하고 있고, 이제 해외 영업에서 더 큰 역할을 찾고 있다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You have worked in logistics for five years and now want more responsibility in global sales.

intent.ko: 지금 회사에서 많이 배웠고 이제 더 넓은 시장에서 일하고 싶다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say you have learned a lot, but now want to work in a wider market.

wk_088.sample_en: I've learned a lot there, and I'm grateful for that. Now I feel ready for a wider market.

sample_gloss.ko: 지금 회사에서 많이 배웠고 감사하지만, 이제 더 넓은 시장으로 갈 준비가 됐다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You are grateful for what you gained there and now feel prepared for a broader market.

intent.ko: 강점 하나와 그걸 보여 주는 짧은 사례를 말해보세요
intent.en: Name one strength and back it up with a short example.

wk_089.sample_en: I'd say staying organized. For example, last year I ran twelve projects at once and all of them finished on time.

sample_gloss.ko: 체계적인 정리가 강점이라며, 작년에 12개 프로젝트를 동시에 맡아 모두 제때 끝냈다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: Your strength is keeping things in order, and last year all twelve of your projects finished by the deadline.
